2610.13157.title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
2610.13157.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%. These confirm that SOAR significantly improves performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks while effectively mitigating evidence fabrication, fostering more faithful and grounded reasoning with enhanced robustness.
2610.13157.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）對於搜索代理經常遭受證據製造的問題，這是一種失效模式，其中代理繞過外部信息（$E_{ext}$）並製造不正確的答案。我們認為這種製造源於對不可靠內部知識（$E_{int}$）的過度依賴，因為推理過程的固有不透明性使得它成為捷徑。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SOAR（源感知強化學習），這是一種將單一推理轉變為源明確的推理過程的範式。SOAR（i）通過源感知工作流程將$E_{ext}$和$E_{int}$解耦為平行的可觀察流，並且（ii）納入源一致獎勵以指導策略演變。通過使信息源的歸因變得明確，SOAR能夠在不同的知識流之間進行精確的信用分配。評估顯示，SOAR在3B和7B骨幹上分別超越基準7.3%和5.4%，同時將證據製造減少74.8%。這些結果確認SOAR顯著提高了在知識密集型基準上的性能，同時有效減輕證據製造，促進了更真實和扎實的推理，並增強了穩健性。
